derivation: a primitive root; to move rapidly; used only as a denominative from H1709 (דָּג);

occurrences.text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
